\begin{example} \end{example}[Generalized Hopf fibration]

Source: petersen:page-0045 ↗ ex:pet-ch1-hopf-higher-dim ↗ ex:pet-ch1-fubini-study

1. ch1:1.4.14In subsection 4.6, set $\rho (t)=\sin t$, $\phi (t)=\cos t$, and $0\le t\le \pi /2$. The completed quotient is the generalized Hopf fibration $S^{2n+3}\to \mathbb {CP}^{n+1}$, and the Fubini--Study metric is \[ dt^2+\sin ^2t\, (g+\cos ^2t\, h). \] \end{example}
